name: gryz
description: One shared memory your AI assistants read and write across tools and sessions — you own it and manage it from the Gryz dashboard. Plus documents your assistants can edit safely, private Notes, Skills, and Tasks, over MCP with OAuth sign-in.

com.openai.interface.longDescription: Gryz gives your AI assistants durable, shared memory that works across tools and sessions. Store preferences, project decisions, and stable facts that outlast any conversation. Plus create and safely edit Markdown/HTML documents, keep private Notes, manage Skills, and track Tasks — all with version history and OAuth sign-in. Your data stays private and is never used for training.
capabilities: Store and recall facts across sessions
Maintain private notes for each user
Track tasks with status and priority
Safe concurrent editing with version checks
Granular AI access controls per document
Search and filter across all content

com.openai.publication.release_notes: Initial release: Core memory operations (remember, recall, forget), document creation and editing with version history, private notes, skills management, and tasks tracking. OAuth authentication with Dynamic Client Registration. All data private to user account.
